title: 第24章 从长计议
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
矿场。

    清风宗人即使紧赶慢赶也终究慢了一步。

    以上官鸿为首的一众金丹长老赶到之时，矿场早已近乎人去楼空。

    五位金丹长老此刻腾空在矿场上空，神识迅速扩散扫描。

    事实证明，厉行天说的传送阵不稳定，是真的非常不稳定，这群金丹神识一扫，就扫到有几位矿工此刻仍然在他们的神识范围之内。

    其中一位长老迅速开口：

    “四周还有矿工尚未能逃脱。”

    “你们去追，这里我自己搜。”上官鸿眉目低垂，声音平静。

    “好……”

    其余长老也懂对于上官鸿来说，这是他唯一能突破元婴的机缘，恐怕此刻他表面平静，但内心估计早已怒火滔天。

    他是最不期望这里出事的，此刻把这里交给上官鸿，或许也是最好的选择。

    上官鸿飞身而下，踏入矿场土地的第一眼就看见了面前被吸成人干的墨尘长老。

    他缓缓伸出手去，仔细探查了一遍墨尘长老的情况。

    很快，上官鸿迅速得出结论，墨尘长老是被人吸干的。

    而且是活着的时候，体内的血气被一通吸干的，甚至毫无还手之力。

    起码是金丹后期左右的邪修才能做到。

    “废物！”

    上官鸿强忍心中怒气，没将这一具干尸直接轰成灰烬。

    毕竟此刻他依靠宗门，就不能将事情做的太过难看。

    上官鸿深呼吸一口气，只能带着最后的期望向矿场内部走去。

    此刻只能希望里面情况一切正常，里面历经多年打造的阵法依旧稳固的同时，血池蕴含的血气还依旧存在。

    那些可都是自己突破元婴期的最大依仗。

    自己时间已然不算太多，上官鸿天资并不算好，如今一路爬到清风宗长老一职，不知耗费多少心血。

    吃过多少白眼，挨过多少屈辱。

    如今……这就叫他到此为止，上官鸿又怎能接受。

    其实不用真正踏入矿洞之内，当上官鸿用神识扫过矿洞，就明白，这一切都没了。
content_en:
Mine.

    Even if the Qingfeng Sect members hurried and hurried slowly, they were still a step too late.

    When a group of Jindan elders headed by Shang Guanhong arrived, the mine was almost empty.

    The five Jindan elders were soaring over the mine at this moment, and their spiritual consciousness quickly spread and scanned.

    Facts have proved that what Li Xingtian said about the instability of the teleportation array is really very unstable. With a sweep of their golden elixir consciousness, they found that several miners were still within the range of their consciousness.

    One of the elders quickly spoke:

    "There are still miners around who have not yet been able to escape."

    "You go after him, I'll search here myself." Shangguan Hong lowered his eyebrows and spoke calmly.

    "Okay..."

    The other elders also understand that for Shangguan Hong, this is his only chance to break through the Nascent Soul. I am afraid that at this moment, he may be calm on the outside, but he is probably already furious in his heart.

    He least expected anything to happen here, so leaving this place to Shangguan Hong might be the best choice at this moment.

    Shangguan Hong flew down, and the first time he stepped into the mine land, he saw Elder Mo Chen being sucked to death in front of him.

    He slowly stretched out his hand and carefully inspected Elder Mo Chen's situation.

    Soon, Shangguan Hong came to the conclusion that Elder Mo Chen was sucked dry.

    And while he was still alive, the blood in his body was sucked dry, leaving him completely unable to fight back.

    At least only evil cultivators around the late stage of Jindan can do it.

    "Trash!"

    Shangguan Hong suppressed the anger in his heart and did not blast the mummy into ashes.

    After all, he relied on the sect at this moment, so he couldn't make things too ugly.

    Shangguanhong took a deep breath and could only walk inside the mine with his last hope.

    At this moment, we can only hope that everything inside is normal. While the formations built over many years are still stable, the blood energy contained in the blood pool is still there.

    Those are the biggest support for me to break through the Nascent Soul stage.

    I don’t have much time anymore, and Shangguan Hong’s talent is not very good. Now he has climbed all the way to the position of elder of Qingfeng Sect, and I don’t know how much effort he has spent.

    How many looks I have received and how many humiliations I have endured.

    Now...this is the end of it for him. How can Shangguanhong accept it?

    In fact, there is no need to actually step into the mine. When Shangguan Hong scans the mine with his spiritual consciousness, he will understand that all this is gone.
